BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)
CLASS: BAM/BBA/IMBA  SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: MANAGEMENT  SESSION: MO/2025

SUBJECT: MN201 PERSONALITY DEVELOPMENT
TIME: 02 Hours  FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 10 questions of 2 and 3 marks, and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Define “personality development” and state one way it influences work environment. [2] 1 2
Q.1(b) “AI adoption is increasing in educational institutions”. Do a SWOT analysis of the same.  [3] 2 4


Q.2(a) Differentiate Allport’s central and secondary traits; give one brief example for either
type.
[2] 1 2
Q.2(b) Arrange Swami Vivekananda’s Panchakosha (five sheaths) from external to internal
levels.
[3] 1 1


Q.3(a) A project is missing deadlines due to unclear role ownership. How would you solve this
at a teambuilding level?
[2] 4 3
Q.3(b) Differentiate between selective and intensive listening. Give one example of each. [3] 3 2


Q.4(a) Name two non-verbal communication cues that are important in a job interview. Give
reason why.
[2] 2 4
Q.4(b) Give two reasons for success and a hurdle that prevents it.  [3] 1 1


Q.5(a) List one similarity and one difference between communication skills and interpersonal
skills.
[2] 2 2
Q.5(b) At your office, you saw a person being discriminated because of their gender identity.
Which two interpersonal skills would you demonstrate to help the person?
[3] 3 4
